Its /projects and /news streams frequently name the technology and supplier behind a bank initiative.

candidates.access_status: open web, some content may be behind partner/special-project labels
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted editorial content; headline/metadata monitoring and linking normally acceptable

negative_findings.description: Targeted Ukrainian-language search for Mind.ua investigative reporting on bank IT tenders and suppliers ('банки ІТ-рішення тендер постачальник розслідування') returned only procurement-platform company profiles (e-Tender, SmartTender) and a Ukrposhta equipment tender — no bank-specific vendor investigation surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Mind.ua confirmed as a relevant outlet, but no evidence in this pass that it runs a recurring bank-IT-procurement investigative line.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumes local media expose contract disputes and tender outcomes; that assumption is unproven for Mind.ua and may need to be met by Prozorro/NBU primary sources handled by other cells.

negative_findings.description: Interfax-Ukraine's full newswire is a paid subscription product; only free news pages and the press-release channel were observed. No pricing, feed format or licence terms were retrieved.
negative_findings.result_summary: Free surface confirmed; commercial feed terms unknown.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If wire coverage proves to be the fastest surface for partnership announcements, a licensing decision is needed before any systematic collection.

negative_findings.result_summary: Feed discovery not performed in this pass.

negative_findings.description: delo.ua, historically a major Ukrainian business outlet, did not appear as a live result; the search surfaced delo.net.ua and an English Wikipedia entry about an unrelated DELO instead. Status is a hypothesis, not a verdict — no fetch was attempted.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If delo.ua is defunct or rebranded, its archive may still hold pre-2022 vendor-deal history worth a one-off harvest.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Ukrainian trade publication was found that focuses specifically on banking core systems, card processing or ATM/self-service estates (the Printec-adjacent niche); coverage of these topics is scattered across general fintech and business outlets.
negative_findings.result_summary: No niche bank-technology trade press identified in Ukraine.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor-level signal for core banking, processing and self-service will have to be assembled from generalist outlets plus vendor and regulator primary sources.

coverage_gaps.description: Self-service/ATM, core-banking replacement and card-processing vendor coverage is thin in Ukrainian trade media relative to neobank and payments-app coverage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this media cell with vendor newsrooms, NBU registers and Prozorro procurement data; run targeted uk queries on банкомат, самообслуговування, процесинговий центр,core-banking АБС against each outlet's on-site search.

coverage_gaps.description: Paywalled/subscription tiers at Forbes Ukraine, NV Business, Mind and the Interfax wire will hide exactly the deal-detail paragraphs the cell exists to capture.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide a subscription budget for one or two outlets; otherwise restrict collection to headline+lede and rely on aggregator and cross-outlet reporting for detail.

coverage_gaps.description: On-site search endpoints and archive pagination depth were not probed for any outlet, so historical backfill feasibility (how far back vendor-deal items are retrievable) is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each priority domain, test the on-site search URL pattern and pagination limit, and check web.archive.org coverage as a fallback for older items.

coverage_gaps.description: Russian-language Ukrainian editions (several of these outlets historically published ru versions, and psm7 maintains multiple language paths) were not searched, since the run scope lists uk and en only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: If historical backfill before 2022 is needed, extend queries to ru-language variants of the same domains; flag for run owner as a scope decision.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell's actor map is currently seeded mainly by outlets and a few named entities (monobank/Fintech-IT Group, PayForce, UAPAY, Zen.com, e-Tender, SmartTender, SoftServe); no systematic vendor roster is yet in place to filter feeds.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ingest the UAFIC annual fintech catalogue and the PaySpace Magazine Awards long-lists as the seed roster, then expand by snowballing names out of matched articles.

brief: Ukraine has a dense, mostly open Ukrainian-language trade-media layer for banking and payments: FinClub and PaySpace Magazine (psm7.com) are the two genuinely sector-specialist outlets, Ekonomichna Pravda, Mind.ua, Forbes Ukraine and AIN.ua supply deal, ownership and funding reporting, and Interfax-Ukraine provides the English wire that carries Ukrainian items into international coverage. The most efficient way to work this cell is a two-layer design: pointer sources (UAFIC's annual fintech catalogue, PaySpace Awards long-lists, UKR.NET per-outlet feeds) to build and maintain the actor roster, then keyword-filtered section crawls of the outlets themselves. Two structural caveats: sponsored/branded content (FinClub spetsproiekty, special.ain.ua, Interfax press-release channel) is abundant and must be tagged as vendor-authored rather than treated as independent reporting, and paywalls at Forbes, NV and the full Interfax wire will hide deal detail. The clearest weakness is that no Ukrainian outlet specialises in core banking, processing or ATM/self-service technology, so that vendor niche must be covered from regulator, procurement and vendor primary sources rather than from this cell.
